journey.name: wear restore 12 words
journey.description:
Restoring the test wallet's 12-word phrase on the watch, one word per screen, opens Home on the Balance page with the wallet's balance, under the loading ring of the first sync. The word screen itself (progress, suggestion chips, rotary crown) is covered by `restore-word-entry.xml`. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Fresh app, see journeys/wear/README.md › Fresh app. Backend: hosted regtest, with a funded wallet (README › The test wallet). The first sync of a funded wallet takes about 3.5 minutes there. The word screens block screenshots, so check them with `android layout` only.

actions.action: Type the test phrase (README › Typing several words)
Verify the passphrase screen: the title (tag "RestorePassphraseTitle") reads "Passphrase?"
Verify from a screenshot that the orange loading ring runs around the screen edge over a dimmed Bitkit mark
Dump `android layout` every 15 s until it lists "WatchHomeBalance", for up to 5 minutes
Verify "WatchHomeBalance" reads the wallet's balance, a number above 0
